metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for Spring Boot 3.0 metrics migration using Observation conventions. It does not overlap with existing skills (Maven setup, cache eviction) and addresses a specific upgrade workflow not covered by peer candidates (MongoDB test infrastructure, configuration properties, database dependencies). The semantic capability—reimplementing custom metrics tagging via ServerRequestObservationConvention—is novel and well-supported by Spring Boot 3.0 migration guidance.
